@context.desktop.account.waiting.left: How long the short code on screen still works; {n} is whole minutes.
@context.desktop.reason.offline_signout: After Sign out when the website could not be reached: the sign-in was removed here, not on the website.
@context.desktop.carry.text: Studio's first start: the separate 0.4 apps' settings, recent files and recovery copies are copied into Studio (SD.8).

desktop.account.title: Sign in to getcadcraft.com
desktop.account.signed_out.text: Signing in lets this app open and save your cloud drawings. You get a short code here and approve it on the website, in your own browser. Nothing secret is typed or copied.
desktop.account.waiting.title: Approve this code on the website
desktop.account.waiting.text: Your browser has opened getcadcraft.com/device. Check that it shows this code, then approve it.
desktop.account.waiting.own: Only approve a code shown here, in your own app.

desktop.account.waiting.left.=1: The code works for 1 more minute.
desktop.account.waiting.left.one: The code works for {n} more minute.
desktop.account.waiting.left.other: The code works for {n} more minutes.

desktop.account.signed_in.title: Signed in
desktop.account.signed_in.text: This computer stays signed in until you sign out here, or remove it on getcadcraft.com under Account, Security.
desktop.account.only_desktop: This window works only inside the CadCraft desktop app.
desktop.reason.throttled: Too many codes in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
desktop.reason.expired: The code ran out before it was approved. Ask for a new one.
desktop.reason.denied: The sign-in was turned down on the website.
desktop.reason.revoked: This computer was signed out on getcadcraft.com. Sign in again to use your cloud drawings; nothing on this computer was lost.
desktop.reason.offline_signout: Signed out on this computer. The website could not be reached: the sign-in is also listed on getcadcraft.com/account/security, where you can remove it.
desktop.reason.keystore: This computer's credential store refused the sign-in.
desktop.carry.title: Setting up CadCraft Studio
desktop.carry.text: Bringing over your settings, recent files and recovery copies from the separate apps installed before.
